method: CBE publishes inflation as a rate and never as a level. This chains EG.CPI.HDL.MOM, the published month-on-month headline rate, from a base of 100 in December 2004. Recomputing year-on-year inflation from it reproduces the published EG.CPI.HDL.YOY to a median of 0.001 percentage points. It does not reproduce 2009 and 2010, where CAPMAS rebased the basket and a chained index cannot see the link: a comparison spanning those two years carries roughly 1.5 percentage points of error in that one year.
